info.title: CREW API
info.description: CREW by SAMPLEDGE REST API. All tenant routes are scoped to the tenant in the bearer token and protected by PostgreSQL Row-Level Security. Send `Idempotency-Key` on POST requests you may retry. Lists use cursor pagination (`limit`, `cursor`).
